description: Implementation of TavusVideoService class for avatar-based video generation and streaming via Tavus API, including participant management, frame processing, and audio/video data handling.

classes.name: TavusVideoService
classes.description: A service class that proxies audio to Tavus and receives audio/video streams, managing participant sessions and frame processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TavusVideoService with API credentials, session, and configuration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Tavus transport client and callbacks.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disconnects the client.

methods.name: _on_participant_joined
methods.description: Handles participant joining event, starts capturing video and audio.

methods.name: _on_participant_video_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming video frames from participants.

methods.name: _on_participant_audio_data
methods.description: Processes incoming audio data from participants.

methods.name: get_persona_name
methods.description: Retrieves the current persona name from Tavus.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Tavus session and initializes audio destination.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the session and ends conversation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the session and resets state.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling interruptions, TTS, and transport readiness.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions
methods.description: Handles interruption frames by resetting send tasks and notifying Tavus client.

methods.name: _end_conversation
methods.description: Ends current conversation and resets participant state.

methods.name: _create_send_task
methods.description: Creates asynchronous task for sending audio frames.

methods.name: _handle_audio_frame
methods.description: Resamples and buffers audio frames for transmission.

methods.name: _send_task_handler
methods.description: Continuously sends buffered audio frames to Tavus client.
